text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Elevated 504/502 responses from ELBs in eu-west-3 (multiple target groups). Error spike began ~16:38 UTC. Aggregate 5xx ~47% for frontend TGs. Auto-alerting on SLA threshold.
lee: I'm oncall. Starting triage. Which AZs are noisy? Any EBS errors?
priya: Seeing a pattern: ELB healthcheck failures primarily in eu-west-3a and eu-west-3c. Cloudwatch shows frequent EBS detach/attach retries on a subset of hosts during scale events. Also increased conn reset counts on ENI stats.
charlie: App logs show timeouts at the proxy layer with upstream 504. No obvious application exceptions — downstream connections failing.
emma: Quick mitigation proposal: 1) reduce Route53 weight for eu-west-3 to 30% 2) enable cross-zone LB 3) increase ASG fallback capacity in eu-west-1 for overflow 4) open AWS case for ENI/EBS investigation.
ops-bot: Runbook step executed: post to status page and notify CS when P1 created.
lee: Priya, can you run the weight adjustment? I'll seed ASG scale and start draining.
priya: Updating Route53 weighted record now. CLI: ```aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z0EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-3","Weight":30,"TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"18.134.56.78"}]}}]}'```
charlie: I'm scheduling target drains for unhealthy instances in eu-west-3c. Note: some hosts fail to reattach EBS for the model cache, hitting attach timeout. Collecting dmesg.
priya: Weight pushed at 16:45 UTC; DNS propagation looks in-flight (TTL 30). Traffic to eu-west-3 down ~65% by 16:48. 5xx trend flattening but still intermittent.
lee: Starting ASG scale-up in eu-west-1 by +30 instances to soak overflow traffic. Hold on scaling in eu-west-3 until AWS responds about attach failures.
aws-support-bot: AWS case opened: case-id 9876543210. Severity: production system disruption. Requesting host-level logs, ENI counters, and EBS attach traces. Assigned to EU networking team.
charlie: Dropped sample kernel lines (uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1768895000): ```
[ 1223.412345] eni1: tx timeout, resetting
[ 1223.412789] kernel: sd 2:0:0:0: [sdf] Synchronizing SCSI cache
[ 1224.001234] EBS: attach timeout vol-0a1b2c3d
```
emma: Enabling cross-zone load balancing on ELB and increasing connection draining timeout to 300s to allow graceful transfer.
ops-bot: NOTE: healthchecks for frontend TG adjusted to 30s interval with 3 healthy threshold.
priya: After draining, 9 instances in eu-west-3 were replaced; a subset returned with successful mounts, others still show EBS attach errors.
lee: Any customer reports? Jacob from CS?
emma: CS reported two enterprise customers experiencing intermittent failures for a 12-min window. Not yet SLA-impacting per our initial calc but flagged. Sent workaround instructions to use dedicated endpoints.
aws-support-bot: AWS initial triage: observed elevated host-level interrupt and EBS controller retries in eu-west-3a. Hypothesis: storage backend issue causing attach retries and network interrupts. Engaging storage and hypervisor teams. ETA for deeper analysis 30-60m.
charlie: Ran tcpdump on an affected instance and shared pcap to AWS: ```tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/pcap.pcap host 10.0.12.34 and port 443```
priya: Noted a small number of ASGs in eu-west-3 hit attach limits during parallel scaling. We'll avoid larger scale-up in that AZ; prefer eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 for now.
lee: Rebalance plan: keep eu-west-3 at 30% weight for now. Scale eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 to absorb traffic. Monitor 5xx and latency. If stable, gradually bring eu-west-3 weight up by 10% increments every 10m.
aws-support-bot: AWS update: identified noisy hypervisor host hosting multiple of our instances in eu-west-3a; performing live migration of affected instances. Also running backend EBS repair on volumes showing attach failures.
charlie: Post-migration, we see a marked decrease in ENI resets on those hosts. However, there's still a residual 5xx tail in eu-west-3c.
emma: I'm going to create temporary NAT throughput limits in eu-west-3c to prevent connection storms from overwhelming edge proxies. Applying now.
priya: DNS TTL lowered to 20s to speed future rollbacks if required.
lee: Good. Customer comms: updated status page and sent interim note to impacted customers. CS has templates ready for follow-up.
ops-bot: Reminder: attach incident tag 'network-elb-ebs-euw3' to ticket tracker.
charlie: Logs uploaded and linked in AWS case. AWS says mitigation may be complete once live migration finishes; ETA 25m.
aws-support-bot: AWS update: live migration finished for noisy host set; storage backend repairs applied to several volumes. Monitoring backend metrics for 60 minutes.
priya: Observed 5xx drop to <6% in eu-west-3 after migrations; latency converging to baseline. Gradually raising eu-west-3 weight to 50% at 17:58 UTC.
lee: Monitoring system and watch for repeat EBS attach errors. If attach errors reappear, rollback Route53 weight and open priority escalate.
emma: Confirming no new detach errors in the last 20 minutes. CS reports no new customer complaints.
lee: Preparing handoff. My shift ends at 00:00 UTC. Summary for night: incident caused by host-level network and EBS controller issues in eu-west-3a/3c; mitigations: Route53 weight reduction, cross-zone LB, ASG scaling in other regions, ELB connection draining, AWS live migration and storage repairs. Current status: eu-west-3 at 70% weight, 5xx < 3%, monitoring stable. AWS case 9876543210 remains open for post-incident analysis.
charlie: I'm owner for logs and incident timeline. Priya will own DNS/playbook updates. Emma will own customer comms.
aws-support-bot: AWS final: closing case as mitigation complete; root cause investigation in progress on AWS side. Case closed: 9876543210 (mitigated).
lee: Marking mitigated at 18:40 UTC. Creating follow-up actions: - add automated alarm for EBS attach retries - limit parallel scaling in single AZ - runbook for quick Route53 weight change - add postmortem meeting tomorrow 08:30 UTC.
emma: CS follow-ups scheduled; no SLA credits requested at this time.
ops-bot: Incident closed in slack thread. Please upload final timeline and notes to: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/1768895000
lee: Thanks team. If anything regresses tag me and reopen.
